t: You're looking at a set of gates, gatepiers and railings at Prince of Wales Gate, in the City of Westminster. The entrance takes its name from Edward VII, who was King of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions, and Emperor of India, from January 1901 until his death in 1910. He is the person this gate is named for. Take a moment to look at the ironwork and the stone piers that carry it, which are what this listing protects.
